method: Direct visual inspection of QA18 pages 11-15; exact rendered pixel comparison of QA18 pages 1-10 against the prior all-page QA17 direct visual review. All 15 current pages therefore covered.

page_findings.1-10: Every page has the exact rendered pixel SHA-256 of the prior directly inspected QA17 release. Title, abstract, methods, equations 1-14, four figures and Table 1 remain legible; Figure 4(c1) still reads last active layer.
page_findings.11: The complete fuller structural-limitation paragraph, threshold caveats and detector/timing discussion are readable; the page ends naturally before Conclusion.
page_findings.12: Conclusion is together on one page, followed by availability, acknowledgments, AI disclosure and Appendix A identity; no crowding or clipping.
page_findings.13: Table 2, calibration/split provenance, Appendix B, and all eight response-bin rows of Table 3 legible.
page_findings.14: Table 4 and classifier explanation legible; references 1-16 start below the appendix without detached labels.
page_findings.15: References 17-25 continue with intact titles, identifiers and links. Deliberate white space after the final entry is preferable to compressing text to an arbitrary page target.

findings: No clipping, overlap, missing glyph, unreadable figure/table text, detached caption or unresolved citation observed. The Conclusion starts at the top of page 12 and all 25 references are legible across pages 14-15.
